# Astera Loader plugin API header

- `include/al/al_plugin.h`: plugin API 1.8, copied unchanged from Astera
  Loader commit `888a02226488c25a32563642d5d797c765bdd69d` (release 0.2.3),
  `include/al/al_plugin.h`, SHA-256
  `a8e92a8d74076d0f118023de82ef2229490111421e5e81be7a9a840c028b7654`.
- Licence: MIT, `LICENSE` (copied from the same commit).
- Source: <https://github.com/wowo-dot/AsteraLoader>.

Update it only by copying a newer release's header and recording the commit
and hash here. Plugins built for API 1.8 keep working with any 1.x Astera
Loader of 1.8 or later.
